title: SCE wins tentative ruling in Eaton wildfire liability case, Bloomberg News reports
summary: A California judge has tentatively denied a request to hold Southern California Edison (SCE) automatically liable for billions in property losses from the Eaton wildfire. Insurance companies sought to apply a state law for automatic liability, but the judge's ruling came after investigators determined electrical arcing from an out-of-service SCE transmission tower caused the 2025 fire. SCE, which faces nearly 1,000 lawsuits, welcomed the decision.
